About this item

  • Compact Size — Easy to Hold, No Camera Block. — Small and lightweight, it fits neatly behind your iPhone 16 Pro without covering the camera — easy to slip into a pocket, backpack, or purse.
  • 10,000mAh Capacity — 2× iPhone 16 Pro Recharge. — Delivers about two full charges for your iPhone 16 Pro, keeping you powered during commutes, road trips, or a long day on campus.
  • 20W PD + 22.5W SCP Fast Charging — 55% in 30 Minutes. — Supports 20W PD USB-C and 22.5W SCP USB-A, giving your iPhone 16 Pro a 55% boost in just 30 minutes — perfect when you need power fast while traveling or between classes.
  • Smart LED Display — Know Your Power at a Glance. — The clear digital battery display shows exactly how much charge remains, so you’ll never be caught off guard in the middle of your day.
  • Dual-Device Charging — Share Power Anytime. — With USB-C and USB-A ports, you can charge two devices at once — power your phone and earbuds together, or share with a friend during a flight or road trip.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Compact and light charger. Does the job, would recommend.
    Reviewed in the United States on November 7, 2025
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Title says it all. Its a small 10k portable charger. Wont give you too many charges. But enough to get you from 20 or less percent to full and say half of another charge.

    It is slightly thicker than i imagined it’d be, but its not big at all. Basically a box of playing cards, but a bit taller.

    I personally like this charger because when the device its charging hits its limit (if you enable charge limits in battery settings) the portable charger stops sending power and turns off. This prevents overcharging and deterioration of the battery over time.

    The above situation isnt what most ppl look for, but for me its a suuuper important feature when using portables to know that i can plug in a device and not worry about it charging “forever” and harming my devices and to not wastefully drain the portable’s energy.

    Again, good charger, does what i look for in a charger. Highly affordable, no issues yet. Would buy again.

About this Item

  • Compact Size — Easy to Hold, No Camera Block. — Small and lightweight, it fits neatly behind your iPhone 16 Pro without covering the camera — easy to slip into a pocket, backpack, or purse.
  • 10,000mAh Capacity — 2× iPhone 16 Pro Recharge. — Delivers about two full charges for your iPhone 16 Pro, keeping you powered during commutes, road trips, or a long day on campus.
  • 20W PD + 22.5W SCP Fast Charging — 55% in 30 Minutes. — Supports 20W PD USB-C and 22.5W SCP USB-A, giving your iPhone 16 Pro a 55% boost in just 30 minutes — perfect when you need power fast while traveling or between classes.
  • Smart LED Display — Know Your Power at a Glance. — The clear digital battery display shows exactly how much charge remains, so you’ll never be caught off guard in the middle of your day.
  • Dual-Device Charging — Share Power Anytime. — With USB-C and USB-A ports, you can charge two devices at once — power your phone and earbuds together, or share with a friend during a flight or road trip.
